messages:
maya (prod PM): quick thread: migrating embed schema v1->v2 for pegasus-embed. need a safety valve + tenant opt-in for normalization changes. short takes pls.

ryan (platform): changing normalization will shift cosine numbers; some tenants use hard thresholds in prod. risk of false negatives.

selene (research): bench note: v2 (l2-normalized) vs v1 (unnormalized) => mean cosine shift ~0.04, semantic-search AUC drop ~0.9% abs on our slice. long-tail worst-case larger.

jia (customer-success): Beacon (large tenant) says thresholds will break. they want shadowing + a per-tenant delta report before cutover.

maya (prod PM): proposal:
- default: no automatic migration; tenants must opt-in via Console
- opt-in flow: shadow 100% for 7 days, provide delta report + calibration tips
- pin option: allow tenants to pin v1 for 90d soft pin while they update infra
- require long-tail eval slice + calibration script bundled with release notes

ryan (platform): infra work: per-tenant variant-routing flag + shadowing hook + delta-report job. estimate ~5 dev days.

selene (research): will produce calibration script and run long-tail slice. include guidance on adjusting thresholds.

ops-bot: release checklist: https://internal.redwood/ops/release-template :rocket:

maya (prod PM): decision: proceed with opt-in default + 7d shadow + 90d soft pin + per-tenant delta report. i'll update catalog docs and Console UX copy tonight.

jia (customer-success): :white_check_mark: will notify Beacon and collect opt-in decisions.

ryan (platform): :white_check_mark: creating PLAT-2048 ticket for routing + shadowing.

selene (research): :white_check_mark: calibration script + bench runs in flight.

maya (prod PM): thanks — publishing change and scheduling 30m sync with CS & Platform tomorrow.
